WITH budget_values AS (
    SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS amount_left
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount_left) AS overall_avg
    FROM budget_values
)
SELECT event_status,
       AVG(amount_left) AS average_amount_left,
       AVG(amount_left) - overall.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall_average
FROM budget_values
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY event_status
